source_evidence: Exact player 'Hide and prepare to attack after the first shot is fired' directs V Cunning Action Hide and Ready counterattack after first hostile shot; prior order to withdraw Mara's coach remains. Resolve on R1 V initiative6. V uses BA Hide in enclosed coach, actual d20 face1 + base Stealth10 + attuned Luckstone1 =12 vs Derro passive7, succeeds (natural1 not automatic failure on ability check). Uses action Ready one Galepierce physical dart attack against first firing visible enemy if legal range/line; trigger includes hostile spell discharge. Latest D308 Ready-main-Psychic-Blade exception exists, but Galepierce chosen for target beyond60ft, legal physical range40/120, no limited resource expenditure. V dismounts west to(-5,0,0), cost5ft movement; remaining25ft. Mara's previously held reaction triggers when all dismounted: controlled coach withdrawal10ft south center(0,-10), team intact. Moving solid coach exposes V and companions; V's hiding ends when visibly exposed, no free second Hide. S1(65,60,10) already held Lightning Bolt, its existing first-exposed-defender trigger met; releases as reaction, fixed 5ft-wide 100ft line through exposed V(-5,0,0) also catches F(-10,-5,0) by actual line geometry, C(-10,0,0) outside line, coach/horses not hit. S1 concentration ends, R1 reaction spent, no further slot deduction (L3 already1/2). Actual executed Python secrets receipt9bbd541c50b0a06e4f243d43e58d89ff: V Dex save d20=11+8=19/DC12; Fenar visible-effect Danger Sense advantage11/9 keep11+2=13/DC12; both succeed, shared8d6 faces1,5,6,4,6,6,6,6 sum40 lightning half20 each. V48→28/48, F59→39/59 (Rage no lightning resistance), LR already0/6, no concentration on either. V releases Ready reaction immediately after bolt, S1 ~93ft from V in long range, half cover AC15, no hidden advantage or adjacent ally; disadvantage5/19 keep5+9=14 MISS, no damage/Sneak Attack, physical Galepierce no longer carried, lands among rocks near S1's position, exact recovery location to determine when retrieved, not destroyed/auto-returned. V action/BA/reaction spent, 25ft movement remains; pause at same V turn before D5, no further movement/actions chosen. C and F hold prior Ready actions/reactions, C concentration Toll the Dead remains no damage; D1 currently >60ft in prior consistent Euclidean distance convention, no trigger yet. S2 remains holding Lightning Bolt, targets not within100ft with qualifying line/trigger; S3 remains invisible and concentration. D1–D4 unchanged, have not acted. No other damage/resource/coin change or encounter roll. Disclosure: tactical choice was preparing aboard before dismount, not a safe concealed firing position; moved coach revealed V as previously specified. No re-roll or undo of actual damage without player correction.

Caul received code/mandate23:50 D335, no response delivered or policy outcomes verified. Silverward Hessa5gp/workday from332, actual work/payroll/proposals pending, six unpaid voluntary guardian workers, resident independent rights preserved; conditional grant not deed, drainage repaired, structural/parcel/legal verification pending. Mara holds 2 original record leaves, ceramic container, coffer~180gp metal-equivalent/keepsakes in safekeeping/valuation custody not cash/title; copies of Silverward, tower, manor registers and Caul's historical approach sketch (aqueduct/cistern/terraced court/twin gatehouses); V holds original tower directive. Caul personally recognizes V as Sovereign's child, conditional voluntary reform and oversight consultation pending; no peers informed. Father name/fate, other parent, heart, sealing and actual seat location unresolved, WNW bearing from Silverward. Actual seat route/site still needs preparation before expedition beyond Silverward. Other prior pending commissions/correspondence/estate/custody unchanged. Full owner reconciliation pending. V next action: remaining R1 movement or end turn.
